premise: A comet crosses the sky; everyone at the base stops what they're doing, one by one, to look up — and then goes back to work, one rock later.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Comet' (a whole town looking up at a comet), turned: the base shares it, and counts on afterwards.
lesson: Some moments are worth stopping for.

en-US.title: Everyone Looks Up
en-US.text: It was a busy afternoon at the base. Somebody was fixing. Somebody was digging. Somebody was counting rocks. {all:pulse} Then somebody looked up, {canvas:comet 18s} and stopped. {all:face surprised} [gasps] A comet! Gliding across the black sky, trailing its long, glowing tail. [whispers] One by one, everyone stopped. {all:pulse} The fixing stopped. {all:pulse} The digging stopped. {all:wobble} Even the counting stopped, at rock number eighty-four. {all:glow} Nobody said a word. The comet sailed on, slow and silent, as if it had all the time in the world. {all:sparkle} It had. It would be back in about a hundred years. {all:face happy} [happily] So everyone had a very good look. {all:hop} And then? {all:face normal} The fixing, and the digging, and the counting started again. [giggles] {all:wobble} At rock number eighty-five.

es-ES.title: Todos miran arriba
es-ES.text: Era una tarde muy ajetreada en la base. Alguien arreglaba cosas. Alguien cavaba. Alguien contaba rocas. {all:pulse} Entonces alguien miró arriba, {canvas:comet 18s} y se quedó quieto. {all:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Un cometa! Cruzaba el cielo negro con su larga cola brillante. [whispers] Uno a uno, todos se pararon. {all:pulse} Se paró el arreglar. {all:pulse} Se paró el cavar. {all:wobble} Hasta el contar se paró, en la roca número ochenta y cuatro. {all:glow} Nadie dijo nada. El cometa siguió navegando, lento y silencioso, como si tuviera todo el tiempo del mundo. {all:sparkle} Y lo tenía. Volvería dentro de unos cien años. {all:face happy} [happily] Así que todos lo miraron muy bien. {all:hop} ¿Y después? {all:face normal} El arreglar, el cavar y el contar volvieron a empezar. [giggles] {all:wobble} En la roca número ochenta y cinco.
